verdict.rationale: A probe confirmed https://porkbun.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with structured content. Porkbun also publishes llms-full.txt and a set of agent-oriented guides under /llms/: getting-started, register-a-domain, webhook verification, a Cloudflare move, and a GoDaddy migration prompt. It also has an agent-setup page written directly to AI coding agents ("You are an AI coding agent… Do these steps yourself"). Missing for 10: a markdown variant of the main API documentation (documentation.md returned 404) and any community or hands-on corroboration of agents actually using these docs.
